label: early copy phase (outputs 1-3) of long sequences
explanation: Fires almost only in the copy phase (99.7% of mass). It never fires on original-phase steps and barely fires at the <DEL> step (recall_idx 0, 0.3% of mass). Activity is concentrated on the 2nd-4th outputs (recall_idx 1-3 hold about 91% of mass; rate 23% at recall_idx 1-2) and grows with sequence length (L=9 holds 45% of mass, L<=5 is rare). The strongest activations come right after <DEL>, at recall_idx 1-2. Outputs of certain tokens (s, j, f, i, r, b) and inputs a, i, y raise the firing rate, but a token set adds little beyond position. Precision is low (about 0.3): within the early-copy window of long sequences it fires on only about a third of steps, and no token or history variable I tested picks out which ones. Low-level firing near the end of length-9 sequences (recall_idx 7-8) is not captured.
